segments.name: Fintech
segments.description: Issues sponsor-bank deposit accounts and debit, credit and prepaid cards, provides ACH and payment processing, and makes sponsored fintech loans for partner companies.
segments.evidence: The Fintech Solutions business line partners with fintech companies and other technology focused payment-based providers (collectively "partners") to deliver payment, deposit, and sponsored lending products that attract stable, lower-cost deposits and generate fee income.

segments.name: REBL
segments.description: Makes commercial real estate bridge loans to finance the purchase and rehabilitation of multi-family workforce housing properties with existing cash flow.
segments.evidence: Real estate bridge lending ("REBL") is $2.26 billion of loans, or 31% of our total loan portfolio , and consists of commercial real estate bridge loans for purchase and rehabilitation of existing multi-family workforce housing properties that have existing cash flow.

segments.name: Institutional Banking
products: insurance policy cash value-backed lines of credit
lending and banking services to wealth management clients
segments.description: Lends to wealth management clients and investment advisors through securities-backed and insurance policy-backed credit lines and advisor financing.
segments.evidence: Institutional banking is $1.96 billion of loans, or 27% of our total loan portfolio , and includes lending and banking services to wealth management clients

segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Makes SBA-guaranteed small business loans, commercial mortgages and construction loans, and leases vehicle fleets and equipment to businesses and government.
segments.evidence: Small business lending ("SBL") is $1.01 billion of loans, or 14% of our total loan portfolio, and is comprised primarily of Small Business Administration ("SBA") loans, including the 7(a) Loan Guarantee Program and the 504 Fixed Asset Financing Program.

revenueModel.text: Fintech partners pay contractual per-transaction and monthly service fees, card networks pay interchange, and specialty lending borrowers pay interest and fees.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of fees that we earn result from contractual fees paid by our partners, computed on a per transaction basis, and monthly service fees.
